project_description: A hospital system for managing patients, doctors, and appointments.

requirements.requirement_text: The system shall store patient information including name, email and phone.
The system shall store doctor information including name and specialization.
A patient can book an appointment with a doctor.
Every appointment must have a status.
Appointment status must be one of pending, confirmed, cancelled.

constraints: Every table must have a primary key.
Foreign keys must reference existing tables and columns.
